---
name: Bug report
about: Something is broken, errors out, or a result looks wrong
title: ''
labels: bug
---

## What happened

A clear description of the problem.

## How to reproduce

The exact command or steps, for example `bsb run rnn_imdb --smoke`.

## What you expected instead

What you thought would happen.

## Environment

Paste the output of `bsb info` (it reports your OS, architecture, Python, and the exact
library versions), and note whether you are on x86 or ARM64.

## Anything else

Logs, a traceback, or a screenshot if you have one.
